instruction: A candid lifestyle photograph in a medium full shot captures a sunny rooftop under a clear blue sky. In the center foreground, the woman with short bleached hair (R9), wearing a denim jacket and black midi skirt, smiles with arms outstretched. In the background, the woman with purple hair (R7) in a bright green hoodie stands behind her, while the man with puffy hair (R10) in a brown jacket stands on the right, smiling. The group enjoys dancing together in bright, direct sunlight.
